# Partnerships and Media References Dataset This dataset contains 178 structured records documenting selected partnerships, media references, campaigns, publishing projects, and professional milestones connected to the Samuel & Audrey Media Network. Canonical dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/samuelandaudreymedianetwork/partnerships-and-media-references Zenodo DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18665080 Recommended files: - partnerships-and-media-references.jsonl - partnerships-and-media-references.csv - DATA_DICTIONARY.md - SCHEMA.json - CITATION.cff Records: - 178 structured archive records License: CC BY-NC 4.0 Contact: nomadicsamuel@gmail.com
